purpose: Independent practice of C2.3 (equivalent expressions for whole numbers to 50).
student_learning_goal: I can find many equivalent expressions for the same whole number up to 50.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can find many equivalent expressions for the same whole number up to 50.
header.character_watermark: Bella in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Write 8 different ways to make 10. Use addition AND subtraction.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Eight blank slots in a 2x4 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Eight blank expression slots in B&W line-art, 2-row × 4-column grid. Each slot ~2in × 0.7in. Format: '10 = ___ ___ ___'. Header: '8 different ways!'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P1_EIGHT_SLOTS: keywords (ways) name what the slots ask for.

parts.visual_layout: Middle. Six blank slots in a 2x3 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Six blank expression slots in B&W line-art, 2-row × 3-column grid. Each slot ~2.5in × 0.8in. Format: '25 = ___ ___ ___'. Header: '6 different ways!'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P2_SIX_SLOTS: keywords (ways) name what the slots ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Pick your own target between 30 and 50. Write 5 different ways.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. A target slot plus 5 expression slots.

image_placeholders.description: A target slot at the top ('My target: ___') with 5 blank expression slots below in B&W line-art. Total ~7in × 2.5in. Bella thinking-bubble icon top-right.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS04_P3_MY_TARGET: keywords (target, ways) name what the slots ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Accept any target between 30-50 with 5 different equivalent expressions.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find 5 ways to make 50.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation. Watch for children who repeat the same expression — flag for the variety-of-equivalence reteach.
